why: Row 2 shows the bottom half of each shape in row 1. Row 3 shows that bottom half twice, stacked as 1 and 2. The bottom half of the slanted parallelogram is a smaller parallelogram leaning the same way; two of them stacked make the full leaning parallelogram split into 1 and 2, which is option 1. Option 2 leans the wrong way.
trick: Keep the direction of slant; mirror-image options are the usual trap.
